author: musho7-dev
subject: Garage: car/planet info and BUY button in a fixed card under the big car
body:
The info panel and BUY button sat at the top of the scrolling list, so
after scrolling down and tapping a car nothing seemed to happen. They
now live in a card on the left, under the big car (or planet) in the
background, and stay visible however far the list is scrolled. The
title is one line and the background car sits higher to make room.
The lists are shorter too: all 9 planets fit without scrolling.
